body:
Founder real-time: 'can we add windows client to deadweight 2 artifact releases.' Added scripts/build.sh --windows (mingw cross-compile of dw2_client.exe, matching DEADWEIGHT's own --windows flag convention) and a new CI 'windows' job (mingw-w64 + SDL2-devel-2.28.5-mingw) that attaches dw2_client_windows_x86_64.exe + SDL2.dll to every GitHub Release alongside the three existing Linux binaries, plus a D2_Client_Windows_<build>.zip workflow artifact (exe+dll+PLAY.bat+CONSTRUCT). Simpler than DEADWEIGHT's own Windows build: D2's core/http.h is plain-HTTP-only, no PARENA_WITH_TLS anywhere in this repo, so no mbedTLS cross-compile needed -- just SDL2 + winsock via core/net.h's existing _WIN32 shim (already Windows-ready, ported from DEADWEIGHT verbatim). Structurally verified locally: real x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc build against a real local SDL2-mingw tree (reused from shankpit-460's own), zero warnings under this repo's -Wall -Wextra -Werror, file confirms a genuine PE32+ Windows binary. Honestly NOT runtime-tested on actual Windows (no Wine in this sandbox) -- flagged in new docs/WINDOWS_CLIENT_BUILD.md rather than glossed over. Scoped to the client only, matching the literal ask -- dw2_server/dw2_local stay Linux-only, and the new Windows binary isn't wired into the IDUNA app-release signing loop yet (named, cheap follow-on). Updated CLAUDE.md/README.md (this repo's own and the root monorepo CLAUDE.md's D2 row) to drop the now-stale 'no Windows build surface' claim per SAGA/README-Reality. Commit (pending).

⚓ ☃
title: Windows client added to D2's CI + GitHub Release artifacts
